schemeScope: Combined Ordinary scheme. PDF 1–2 cover and note; 3 listening tariffs (and the only print of the 0–6 language deduction); 4–7 transcript (never shown to students; Cuid C fills the top of PDF 7); 7–10 listening answers in the paper's order, the Fógra a hAon grid first (PDF 7), ending with the mark-total boxes on PDF 10; 11 composition marking (tariffs, the (i) Cumas Gaeilge / (ii) Beachtas definitions and their 40% : 60% ratio, the bracketed content note, the examiner's Nóta). The 2016 scheme prints no 40-mark table; 25–26 modified marking (SMM, incl. the composition 40-mark bands on PDF 26). PDF 12–24 are Paper 2; 27 is blank and 28 empty.
reviewMethod: Every paper page (the 2016 Paper 1 is an 8-page question booklet; page 8 is blank) and every applicable scheme page read in the text layer and checked against the printed page (PDF 7, 8 and 11 rendered and compared line by line); each listening prompt and scheme slice is asserted against the PDFs by the builder.

nonPoolDecisions: Listening answers with alternatives (e.g. Ceithre bliana / 4 bliana; Fiche / 20) are accepted answers to one task, not routes.

Card unit for listening: six segment cards, because the Bank plays one recording section as one exercise; every printed question is a separate criterion (19 questions: 18 at 3 and Fógra a Dó 2(a) at 3 + 3; the four Fógra a hAon grid questions included; 60 marks). Separate question cards are not added: they would repeat the same prompts inside that exercise.

Composition: closed choose-two of four sections; each printed title is a 50-mark card. Choice is not a route: no two-section combination cards are published; the choose-two instruction is in each title card’s task requirements. Letter/email and dó/di wording stay inside one response.
The modified marking scheme changes assessment for eligible candidates, not the printed tasks.
sourceFindings: Paper 1 = 160: listening 60 (Cuid A 24 = Fógra 1 12 + Fógra 2 12; Cuid B 24 = Comhrá 1 12 + Comhrá 2 12; Cuid C 12 = Píosa 1 6 + Píosa 2 6) and composition 100 (any two of A–D at 50: Tasc 2, Ábhar 8, Cumas Gaeilge 40).

Scheme PDF 3 prices Fógra 2 as “3 mharc x 4 = 12 mharc” although the paper prints three questions: Fógra a Dó 2(a) asks for two places and its key prices it “3 mharc + 3 mharc”. It is one 6-mark criterion; 1 and 2(b) are 3 each.
Listening language: “Bainfear ó 0 go 6 ar chaighdeán na Gaeilge” is printed only on scheme PDF 3 in 2016; it is one section-level deduction, and cards state it without applying it.

Fógra a hAon is a printed grid (“Líon isteach an t-eolas atá á lorg sa ghreille anseo.”) of four unnumbered questions; as in 2018, the 2016 scheme prints their answers first (PDF 7, under the Cuid C transcript), each as “answer 3 mharc” in the grid's right column. The second row prices its parts (“(01) 1 mharc 476408 2 mharc”) and the third prints a refused answer, “Léine 0”. Each grid question is its own criterion (labelled Greille 1–4 in the app).

The 2016 composition marking prints no headed Tasc, Ábhar and Cumas Gaeilge sections and no 40-mark table: the tariff block (Tasc 2, Ábhar 8, Cumas Gaeilge 40) is the Tasc criterion's text; the bracketed note “[Ní mór ceangal cinnte leanúnach … nach bhfuil ad rem.]” is the content guidance, lifted as the Ábhar criterion's text; the (i) Cumas Gaeilge and (ii) Beachtas definitions (“[(i) agus (ii) sa chóimheas 40% : 60%]”) and the examiner's Nóta go with Cumas Gaeilge. The only printed 40-mark bands are the modified-marking ones (PDF 26).
Paper prints “t-” with ASCII hyphens and “D’fhág” with U+2019; cards keep the paper's characters.
No 2016 Ordinary card existed before this review; the 15 cards are new.
